summary: Iter 62 RETEST after fix for the iter 61 CRITICAL bug. Verified that BodyRoomChat.jsx now imports VolumeX/Headphones (line 15) and declares TTS_TOKEN_KEY (line 19) + TTS_BACKEND_URL (line 20). End-to-end Body Room TTS flow now works: Listen → Loading… → Pause → Resume cycles correctly, audio plays, /api/clarity/tts returns 200, and a second guide-reply TTS click fires its own independent 200 with no shared-state bleed. Zero page errors, zero ReferenceErrors, no webpack overlay. Backend regression suites NOT executed because the review brief flagged this as 'frontend only' and the fix is a 3-line FE-only change with no backend surface touched.
critical_code_review_comments: BodyRoomChat.jsx now lint-clean and runtime-clean. Suggest enabling ESLint `no-undef` on jsx files in the project config so this class of regression (referencing identifiers that are never imported/declared) cannot ship again — was the original RCA from iter 61.

ClarityRelease.jsx line 816 rollback uses `.catch(() => setKeepThread(prev))` — works, but it silently drops the error. Consider surfacing a small toast or aurin-eyebrow hint so the wanderer learns 'memory package not saved — try again' rather than silently reverting; otherwise the toggle visually flickering back to its prior state may confuse a returning user.
